name: tce
description: Context-engineering workflow for Claude Code: ticket → research → plan → implement, plus review, discuss, and design-exploration commands and supporting research agents. Works with any ticket system (tmt, GitHub Issues, Jira, Linear, custom) via per-project config. Project specifics live in .claude/tce/ (created by /tce:init), so the workflow updates centrally without copy/paste.

show_setup_reminders.title: Remind me to run /tce:init in projects that aren't set up yet
show_setup_reminders.description: tce is a ticket → research → plan → implement workflow, plus review, discuss, and design-exploration commands. It does nothing in a project until you run /tce:init, which analyzes the repo, agrees a profile (stack, test/lint/typecheck commands) and a ticket system (tmt, GitHub Issues, Jira, Linear, …) with you, and writes .claude/tce/ + scaffolds thoughts/. Leave this on to have Claude offer /tce:init at the start of any session in an un-initialized project; turn it off to silence that reminder.
